newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London edge up in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London edge up in thin trade.

text.p: Japanese shares traded in London advanced on Tuesday, boosted by further gains on Wall Street, but volumes were low, dealers said.
"It's been a very quiet afternoon," one said. "With the upward movement in New York we've seen some Japanese shares moving up but volume has been very limited."
By 1420 GMT, the Nikei 50 index was at 1,645.68, up 4.49 points or 0.27 percent from Monday's London close.
In Tokyo earlier, the Nikkei 225 closed 80.10 points or 0.42 percent lower at 18,961.00.
